WITH COND1 AS ( SELECT RUNSTATUS_ADDRESS AS ADDRESS, AVG(VIBRATIONX) AS X, AVG(VIBRATIONY) AS Y, AVG(VIBRATIONZ) AS Z FROM ( SELECT * FROM CLWINFO WHERE H_TIMESTAMP < SYSDATE - INTERVAL '24' HOUR AND H_TIMESTAMP >= SYSDATE - INTERVAL '48' HOUR ) GROUP BY RUNSTATUS_ADDRESS ), COND2 AS ( SELECT RUNSTATUS_ADDRESS AS ADDRESS, VIBRATIONX AS X, VIBRATIONY AS Y, VIBRATIONZ AS Z FROM CLWINFO WHERE H_TIMESTAMP >= SYSDATE - INTERVAL '24' HOUR )
SELECT C1.ADDRESS AS ADDRESS, #{FAB_ID} AS FAB_ID, #{FAC_ID} AS FAC_ID, 24 AS TERM1, 48 AS TERM2, ROUND(C1.X, 2) AS AVG_X, ROUND(C1.Y, 2) AS AVG_Y, ROUND(C1.Z, 2) AS AVG_Z, 'ABNORMAL' AS STATE, CASE WHEN (C2.X - C1.X) / C1.X >= 0.5 AND (C2.Y - C1.Y) / C1.Y >= 0.5 AND (C2.Z - C1.Z) / C1.Z >= 0.5 THEN 'X, Y, Z' WHEN (C2.X - C1.X) / C1.X >= 0.5 AND (C2.Y - C1.Y) / C1.Y >= 0.5 THEN 'X, Y' WHEN (C2.Y - C1.Y) / C1.Y >= 0.5 AND (C2.Z - C1.Z) / C1.Z >= 0.5 THEN 'Y, Z' WHEN (C2.X - C1.X) / C1.X >= 0.5 AND (C2.Z - C1.Z) / C1.Z >= 0.5 THEN 'X, Z' WHEN (C2.X - C1.X) / C1.X >= 0.5 THEN 'X' WHEN (C2.Y - C1.Y) / C1.Y >= 0.5 THEN 'Y' WHEN (C2.Z - C1.Z) / C1.Z >= 0.5 THEN 'Z' ELSE NULL END AS DIR FROM COND1 C1 LEFT JOIN COND2 C2 ON C1.ADDRESS = C2.ADDRESS WHERE ( C2.X >= 1.2 AND C2.Y >= 1.2 AND C2.Z >= 1.2 ) AND ( (C2.X - C1.X) / C1.X >= 0.5 OR (C2.Y - C1.Y) / C1.Y >= 0.5 OR (C2.Z - C1.Z) / C1.Z >= 0.5 )
